description: Live-probe a stdio MCP server command: spawns it twice, runs initialize plus tools/list both times, and diffs the answers (probe parity), matches the presented tool set and descriptions against exact-hash fingerprints, and derives a server-level risk score from the recorded signals. WARNING: unlike vet_path and vet_package, this EXECUTES the given command on this machine, twice. Live evidence never yields DO-NOT-INSTALL; the harshest live verdict is REVIEW. A probe refused for auth reasons is recorded as a pass; a timeout records no signal.

args.description: Arguments for the command, e.g. the server script path

command.description: Server executable to spawn, e.g. node or npx

name: probe_server
